units.description: Unit of every coordinate, width and radius: grid squares, or scene pixels.

darknessLock.description: Lock the darkness so time of day does not change it.

globalLight.description: Foundry's global illumination, lighting the whole scene.

fog.description: Fog of war exploration: disabled, individual (each user their own), or shared.

fogColours.description: The fog's colours over explored and unexplored ground.

cycle.description: Whether the lighting moves from the base environment to the dark one as darkness rises.

hue.description: 0–1, a fraction of the colour wheel.

intensity.description: How strongly the hue tints the scene, 0–1.

dark.description: The lighting environment at full darkness.

hue.description: 0–1, a fraction of the colour wheel.

intensity.description: How strongly the hue tints the scene, 0–1.

weather.description: A Foundry weather effect key (CONFIG.weatherEffects), or "" for none.

transition.description: The transition shown on entering the scene.

type.description: A Foundry scene transition type, or null for none.

scene.description: The scene's own settings, as its config's Basics, Lighting and Ambience tabs set them; only those given change.

levels.description: Levels to add, bottom to top, stacked above any the scene has.

bottom.description: Floor elevation (scene distance units); with `top`, sets the band.

background.description: Image Foundry draws as this level's background, for this floor alone.

foreground.description: Image Foundry draws over this level's tokens (roofs, canopies).

fog.description: Image shown in unexplored fog on this level.

backgroundColor.description: Colour shown where the level has no background image.

alphaThresholds.description: Image pixels less opaque than this let light and weather through (Foundry's Alpha Threshold).

placement.description: Where the level's images sit (Foundry's Positioning).

visibleLevels.description: Keys of the other levels seen from this one.

key.description: A name other entries use for this feature, as a light switch's `controls` do.

movementCost.description: Difficult ground: what crossing it on foot costs, times the distance (1 ordinary, 2 mud), as Foundry's Modify Movement Cost.

effects.description: Region behaviours on the area's Scene Region.

uuid.description: The Macro to run, by UUID.

items.description: A region behaviour on the area, as Foundry's: Adjust Darkness Level, Suppress Weather, Display Scrolling Text, Pause Game, Execute Macro, Execute Script or Apply Active Effect.

level.description: Key of an entry in `levels`. Omitted: the feature shows on every level.

oneOf.description: A closed, smoothed area of one biome.

halfWidth.description: Half-width at every point (default: the path default).

walls.description: Walls along the centerline: a wall kind as Foundry's Walls palette names them (solid, terrain, invisible, ethereal, window), true for solid, or false for none.

liquid.description: What a river carries (default: water). Ignored for a road.

shade.description: A river's liquid colour, #rrggbb (default: the liquid's usual shade).

bed.description: Texture role of a river's bed, e.g. "sand"; null: no bed (default: the liquid's usual bed).

points.description: Boundary. Split an edge with a collinear point to put a door on part of it.

floor.description: A biome or a pack "floor.<name>" material (default: the room default).

wall.description: A pack "wall.<name>" material to draw the walls in; null leaves them undrawn.

wallKind.description: What kind of walls, as Foundry's Walls palette names them: solid, terrain, invisible, ethereal or window.

ceiling.description: Whether a level above gets a ceiling over the room (false for an open courtyard).

segment.description: Perimeter segment index: segment i runs from point i to point i + 1 (the last closes the loop).

sound.description: A Foundry door sound key (CONFIG.Wall.doorSounds), e.g. "woodCreaky"; null: Foundry's default.

animation.description: How the door animates open; null: Foundry's default.

create.description: Name of a new interior scene to create.

scene.description: Id of an existing scene to link as the interior.

floors.description: An enterable stamp's floors in this scene instead of an interior: names of Levels added above the scene's top, bottom to top, reached by stairs over the stamp.

controls.description: A light switch's targets: the keys of the lamp stamps (with lit and unlit variants) and rooms it turns on and off.

lights.description: A light switch's other targets: ids of AmbientLights already on the scene, shown and hidden.

oneOf.description: A stamp from a loaded pack.

features.description: In drawing order: later features draw above, and earlier rooms own shared walls.
